extracted.name: Roasted Melting Potatoes
extracted.description: These roasted potatoes are amazing; crispy on the outside and melting on the inside, this quick and easy side dish will not disappoint you!
ingredient_lines: 3 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch slices
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees F (260 degrees C) and place oven rack in upper-middle position. Grease a high-rimmed metallic baking sheet with butter.
Combine melted butter, thyme, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Add potatoes and toss until fully coated. Place potato slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven until slightly golden, about 15 minutes.
Flip potatoes over and roast for another 15 minutes.
Flip potatoes and add vegetable broth and garlic; roast until tender, about 15 minutes.
